title: Excellent Riviera classical Spain Tour
text:
Just returned from a 6 night classical tour of spain. We had an excellent guide with Mark who was very informative and helpful. Stayed at the the Don Paco hotel in Seville . Well located and very comfortable with a good breakfast buffet and roof top pool. 
Highlight was visiting the Alcazar palace and the going to a classical flamingo show. Felt safe walking around and enjoyed many great places to eat. 
Fab city with plenty to do
author: squeak28

title: The joyous city
text:
Walking day and night in Seville is joy. Churches, bars, must-see historical sites.
Beautiful places to eat on the street and in the markets.
